title: Iceworm proposal document
prompt: Create one complete 16:9 documentary image for CAMP CENTURY. Image1 establishes the OWNER-APPROVED DRAWING STYLE ONLY: confident detailed ink and charcoal linework, restrained watercolor, paper tooth, blue-white snow, olive winter clothes, sparse rusty ochre objects. Do not copy its composition or subjects unless requested. Any additional image is FACT reference only. Match the drawing style, not a new design system. Full finished composition, large explanatory drawing, legible short English labels integrated into the scene/paper. A freshly generated illustrated historical-analysis document, flat full-frame, not a fake original memorandum. A large ink drawing of an unopened planning folio on a snowy-map workbench; a smaller Camp Century research-camp cutaway illustrates the real experiment. The folio and document margins carry only these accurate short lines: PROJECT ICEWORM; PROPOSAL; About 600 missiles; Over 2,000 possible positions; Approx. 135,000 km2; Never deployed. The counts describe a historical proposal only. No missiles, launch hardware, engineering diagrams, targeting routes, operational network or invented technical layout. Drawing/physical paper objects occupy 75 percent rather than a list on an empty background. All base artwork must be CLEAN: NO yellow highlighting, NO underlines, NO marker strokes, NO selection circles, NO loupes, NO glow or animated accents baked into the image; those are added later in DaVinci Resolve. No generic three-line title card, UI, HUD, floating boxes, fake official seals/signatures/stamps, tiny filler text, placeholders, empty panels, decorative noise or burnt parchment. Use 6 percent safe margins. This is authored explanatory artwork, not an original archival record. No invented quantities, dimensions or measurement curves. No other projects or bases. Text only as explicitly specified.
